newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt expects car tariff report soon-govt.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt expects car tariff report soon-govt.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Tuesday a key government industry body was expected to soon complete its report on the automotive industry.
"I expect the final report of the Productivity Commission will be received by the government quite shortly -- the exact day, I don't know," Howard told parliament.

"And we will bring to a consideration of its recommendations the responsibilities we have to the employees of the motor manufacturing industry, to my long-standing belief that it is unthinkable that this country could not have a viable motor manufacturing capacity and also to an understanding of our obligations as a major trader in an increasingly globalised world economy and also the interests of Australian consumers," Howard said. "In short, we will try and bring down a sensible balanced decision, and a consistent decision."
Ford Motor Co's Australian subsidiary earlier on Tuesday expressed concern about the local car-making industry's profitability if the commission's draft recommendations were adopted.
